title: Dekho ay kufiyo
body:
Dekho ay kufiyo
Haye Zinab, Zainab (x3)
<<MINI>>
Dekho ay kufiyo. Me zainab-e dilgir-e hu (x4)
Sar nange, muje kyu he phiraya (x2) me wari se tathir-e hu
<<DIVIDER>>
Ale ahmed-e ka tamasha, dekhene aaye ho kyu.
Apni ghairat-e ka janaza, dekhene aaye ho kyu.
Bebadan me, do pe lasha, dekhene aa ye ho kyu.
<<MINI>>
Me usi, mazlum-e karbal (x2) ki dukhi hamshir-e hu.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jiska sajda kal pe yazda, me samaya ho Husain.
Gir ke gore pe zamin par, jo na aaya ho Husain.
Sar pe apne jisko tiro ne uthaya, wo Husain.
<<MINI>>
Me usi, mazlum-e karbal (x2) ki dukhi hamshir-e hu.
<<DIVIDER>>
Puchete ho mujse rone, ka sabab ehle japaa.
He tumhari orte parde me or mai be ridaa.
Mere bache mera bhaayi, be khata mara gaya.
<<MINI>>
Me usi, mazlum-e karbal (x2) ki dukhi hamshir-e hu
<<DIVIDER>>
Be kafan jalti zami par, aaj-e bhi sota he jo.
Ashke ki khayti zamin par, aaj-e bhi hota he jo.
Be ridaa me par meri neze pe hi rota hai jo.
<<MINI>>
Me usi, mazlum-e karbal (x2) ki dukhi hamshir-e hu
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo phase gardan se jisko, tere dar be maar-e kar.
Kat-e ke sarlash-e bedar, chordi thi khaake par.
Phir usi ki laash-e par le aaye mujko, nange sar.
<<MINI>>
Me usi, mazlum-e karbal (x2) ki dukhi hamshir-e hu
<<DIVIDER>>
Jiska ghazi so gaye darya kanare tash-e na lag.
Kat gaaye bazu jari par, or kya honga gazab.
Berida me hogayi hu, jiske marne, ke sabab.
<<MINI>>
Me usi, mazlum-e karbal (x2) ki dukhi hamshir-e hu
<<DIVIDER>>
Oor kandho par uthakar, laaye jo Akbar ki lash.
Dafne kardi jisme jalti, khak-e me Asghar ki lash.
Bekafan be ghor-e hai shaah-e bero kar ki lash.
<<MINI>>
Me usi, mazlum-e karbal (x2) ki dukhi hamshir-e hu
Sar nange, muje kyu he phiraya (x2) me wari se tathir-e hu
Dekho ay kufiyo. Me zainab-e dilgir-e hu (x2)
